base.text: The driver-based forecast proved significantly more accurate than the naive top-down approach across all three key metrics. Revenue came in at 24,811 versus a driver-based forecast of 25,585.2, a miss of 3.1 percent, compared to the naive forecast's 5.5 percent overestimation. Operating profit showed the largest divergence between methods: actual results of 2,056 fell short of the driver-based forecast of 1,750.0 by 14.9 percent, whereas the naive forecast understated profit by 22.3 percent. Free cash flow of 1,106.4 was closest to the driver-based estimate of 1,069.2, undershooting by just 3.4 percent, versus the naive forecast's 14.8 percent overestimation.

upside.text: Revenue came in at 24811, slightly below the upside scenario of 25822.1, representing a 4.1% miss. Operating profit delivered 2056, nearly matching the upside forecast of 2024.4, which was off by just 1.5%. However, free cash flow reached 1106.4 against the upside projection of 1360.4, underperforming by 23.0%, primarily driven by higher working capital requirements and capital allocation differences than the scenario anticipated. The naive top-down extrapolation significantly overestimated both revenue and free cash flow, at 26176.5 and 1270.2 respectively, though it notably underestimated operating profit at 1596.5 versus actual 2056, demonstrating the value of the driver-based upside case in capturing operational efficiency that the linear extrapolation missed.

downside.text: Revenue came in below both forecasts, with actual results of 24811 versus the naive forecast of 26176.5 (5.5% miss) and the downside scenario of 25348.3 (2.2% miss). Operating profit significantly outperformed expectations, delivering 2056 against the naive forecast of 1596.5 and the downside scenario of 1480.3, beating both by 22.3% and 28.0% respectively. Free cash flow of 1106.4 fell short of the naive forecast of 1270.2 by 14.8%, and substantially exceeded the downside scenario of 783.9 by 29.1%, driven by strong operational profitability that more than offset the revenue shortfall.

wc_stress.text: Actual revenue of 24811 fell short of the naive forecast by 5.5%, while operating profit outperformed by 22.3%, reaching 2056 versus the predicted 1596.5. Free cash flow came in below the naive expectation by 14.8%, at 1106.4 compared to 1270.2. The working capital stress case was closer on revenue, missing by only 3.1%, but significantly underestimated free cash flow generation, projecting just 429.6 against the actual 1106.4—a 61.2% shortfall driven by overestimation of working capital requirements and their cash impact.

margin_compression.text: Revenue came in at 24811, slightly below the naive forecast of 26176.5 but closer to the margin compression scenario's 25585.2, missing the naive by 5.5 percent. Operating profit underperformed significantly, delivering 2056 against the naive forecast of 1596.5—a beat of 22.3 percent—yet the margin compression scenario projected only 1238.3, missing by 39.8 percent. Free cash flow of 1106.4 exceeded the margin compression forecast of 693.1 by 37.4 percent, though it fell short of the naive projection of 1270.2 by 14.8 percent. The margin compression scenario assumed a sharper deterioration in profitability and cash generation than actually materialized, while the naive extrapolation overestimated both revenue and free cash flow despite underestimating the strength in operating profit.
